nodes.description: 32 px margin-bottom on headings immediately followed by paragraphs; design-system concrete tokens take precedence.

nodes.label: 4-point spacing grid
nodes.description: All margins, padding and gaps selected from multiples of 4 px or the design-system base.
nodes.rationale: Finite tokens promote consistency, developer speed and visual hierarchy.

nodes.label: Spacing tiers
nodes.description: At least three tiers: tight, default and loose; micro through section tiers defined.

nodes.label: Vertical rhythm
nodes.description: Body leading about 1.5; section padding symmetric; paragraph gap about one body size.

nodes.label: Spacing Principles
nodes.description: Documented guidance or claim; not a verification of current implementation.

nodes.label: Horizontal utility clusters
nodes.description: Icon-only gaps 4 px; labeled sibling controls 16 px; cluster-to-labeled control 16 px.

nodes.label: Input label grouping
nodes.description: Label-field gap 4-8 px; between field groups 16-24 px.
nodes.rationale: Equal label-field and field-next-label gaps obscure field ownership.

nodes.label: Proximity grouping
nodes.description: Outer group padding exceeds internal gaps; related elements closer than unrelated groups.
nodes.rationale: Spacing communicates group boundaries more effectively than redundant borders.

nodes.label: Padding versus margin
nodes.description: Padding controls component interiors; margin or parent gap separates siblings.
nodes.rationale: Parent gap avoids surprises from collapsing margins.

nodes.label: Responsive spacing
nodes.description: Reduce section/container space while preserving tier ratios and touch target space.

nodes.label: UX conflict priorities
nodes.description: Accessibility/ethics, mental models, conserved capability, reduced cognitive load before visual novelty.

nodes.label: Hover and active technique palettes
nodes.description: At most two coherent visual changes per state; press deepens or inverts hover motion.

nodes.label: Orthogonal button type style state
nodes.description: Behavior, visual priority and current status are independent dimensions.

nodes.label: Nine-state button contract
nodes.description: Default, hover, active, focus, disabled, loading, success, error, selected.

nodes.label: Loading duplicate prevention
nodes.description: Disable during async request, hold width, expose busy/live region; restore on resolution.
nodes.rationale: Repeat submissions can create duplicate operations or charges.

nodes.label: Interaction and Control Principles
nodes.description: Documented guidance or claim; not a verification of current implementation.

nodes.label: State implementation contract
nodes.description: Every state defines visual appearance, trigger, exit and accessibility hook.

nodes.label: Button feedback timing
nodes.description: Hover 100-150 ms;active 80-120 ms;focus 0 ms;selected 100-200 ms.

nodes.label: Accessible state semantics
nodes.description: Native disabled/focus;aria-busy, pressed, checked, live; accessible names match visible text.

nodes.label: Error recovery state
nodes.description: Specific adjacent recovery message and immediately retryable control.

nodes.label: Navigation link treatment
nodes.description: Text-only navigation styling; underlines only for inline content links.

nodes.label: Session lock
nodes.description: Check .context/LOCK before changes and stop if another agent active.

nodes.label: Preserve and Justify
nodes.description: Do not rewrite earlier agent code for taste; document exact bug and rationale for fixes.
nodes.rationale: Continuity and documented reasoning prevent conflicting arbitrary rewrites.
